title: 10-Level PMCS Checklist for M1078 LMTV

vehicle.type: Truck, Cargo, Light Medium Tactical Vehicle (LMTV), 2-1/2 ton, 4x4
vehicle.variant_note: This file is for the base M1078. M1078A1 uses TM 9-2320-391-10; M1078A1P2 uses TM 9-2320-332-10-1/-2. Confirm the data plate before use.

technical_manual.title: Operator's Instructions Manual for M1078 Series, 2-1/2 Ton, 4x4, Light Medium Tactical Vehicles (LMTV)
technical_manual.edition_used: Reprinted with Basic including Changes 1 and 2; August 2005 Change 2 pagination
technical_manual.status_checked: ACTIVE in Army Publishing Directorate index on 2026-08-16
technical_manual.authority_note: Verify the current authenticated TM and changes through Army ETM/AESIP/LDAC before operational use. This JSON is a structured aid and does not replace the TM, its warnings/cautions, Appendix F lubrication instructions, or DA Form 5988-E/2404.

leak_classification.class_II: Drops form but do not drip from the component.
leak_classification.class_III: Drops form and drip from the component.
leak_classification.rule: Minor Class I/II leakage may be allowable if fluid capacity is monitored. Report Class III leakage to maintenance. Apply stricter component-specific criteria listed in each step.

use_rules: Perform Table 2-1 all-model checks and Table 2-2 M1078 cargo-specific checks.
Execute applicable steps in global_rank order, filtering by installed equipment and mission configuration.
Record every fault on DA Form 5988-E or DA Form 2404 and notify maintenance when directed.
Do not operate with a listed not-fully-mission-capable condition unless authorized under current maintenance policy.
Use the current TM for full warnings, cautions, figures, exact lubrication products, and referenced operating procedures.

checks: Inspect windshield for damage affecting driver vision.
Inspect wiper blades for damage or missing parts.
Check washer-fluid level and service per Appendix F.
not_fmc_if: Windshield is cracked enough to impair driver vision.

checks: Verify shackle pins are not loose.
Verify cab air springs are unpinned and the pin is stowed in its bracket.
Look underneath for fuel, oil, or coolant leakage.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: With engine stopped, verify coolant level is between upper and lower overflow-tank sight glasses.
Inspect for engine oil in coolant.
Inspect radiator cap.
not_fmc_if: Coolant is below the lower sight glass.
Engine oil is present in coolant.
Radiator cap is damaged or missing.
warnings: Release overflow-tank pressure before removing the cap; use extreme care above 180 F.

checks: Remove cap and strainer, visually confirm fuel is present, then reinstall both.
warnings: No smoking, flame, fueling with engine running, overfill, or unrecovered spill.

checks: Verify spare-tire strap is tight and undamaged.
Verify SPARE TIRE knob is at RAISE.
Verify CAB air-spring knob is pushed in and locked right.
Verify latch-indicator button shows the cab is latched.
not_fmc_if: Cab will not latch securely.

checks: Check dipstick and service per Appendix F Note 6.
Inspect all three belts for secure mounting, damage, and operation.
not_fmc_if: Driver belt and at least one other belt are not serviceable.
If the mission requires three occupants, any required belt is unserviceable.

checks: Test forward/backward adjustment and lock.
not_fmc_if: Adjustment mechanism is broken or missing.

checks: Verify extinguisher is installed and undamaged.
Verify pressure is about 150 psi and gauge is not in discharge band.
Verify seal is present.
not_fmc_if: Extinguisher is missing or damaged.
Gauge is in discharge band.
Seal is missing.

checks: With master power ON and appropriate low-air/park conditions, verify STOP, PARK BRAKE, EMERGENCY BRAKE, REAR BRAKE AIR, FRONT BRAKE AIR, and ENGINE OIL PRESSURE indicators illuminate.
not_fmc_if: Any required indicator fails to illuminate under its test condition.

checks: Test windshield-washer switch.
Test windshield-wiper switch.
Start engine and confirm oil-pressure warning behaves correctly.
Verify gauge reads 15-80 psi.
not_fmc_if: Gauge is in red and oil-pressure indicator is illuminated.
Gauge reads below 15 psi.
Oil-pressure indicator fails its functional check or remains illuminated.
warnings: Shut down if the TM oil-pressure warning criteria are met.

checks: At idle, verify 750-850 rpm.
Verify normal operating indication of 160-230 F, accounting for the TM idle/fan note.
not_fmc_if: Gauge is in red and high-engine-temperature indicator is illuminated.

checks: If above 25 inches/red, reset; if still red, stop, service filter, restart, and reassess.
not_fmc_if: Gauge remains above 25 inches/in red after reset and filter service.

checks: Verify both gauges read 65-120 psi.
not_fmc_if: Either gauge is below 65 psi, a brake-air indicator illuminates, or audible alarm sounds.

checks: Verify 26-30 volts.
not_fmc_if: Voltage is below 26 or above 30 volts.

checks: Compare gauge reading with observed tank level from item 4.
With vehicle stopped, pull SYSTEM PARK, select a forward gear at idle, and verify vehicle does not move.
not_fmc_if: Vehicle moves with SYSTEM PARK applied.

checks: Verify WTEC II TEPSS/WTEC III TPSS operates in all ranges and no unresettable service message remains.
not_fmc_if: A range fails or an LED service message cannot be reset.

checks: Test control and indicators.
Test switch when tactical conditions permit.
Monitor all gauges, warning lights, and buzzers; apply immediate operator correction when authorized.
not_fmc_if: A warning indicates malfunction and immediate operator action does not correct it.

checks: Watch for excessive exhaust smoke, unusual noise, rough running, or misfire.
not_fmc_if: Any listed abnormal engine condition is present.

checks: Verify Central Tire Inflation System operates per paragraph 2-23.
Listen for normal discharge near 120 psi.
Check for abnormal noise, binding, poor response, or difficult turning.
not_fmc_if: Steering binds or is unresponsive.

checks: Verify brakes stop the vehicle without pulling.
Listen for chatter, grinding, groaning, or excessive squeal.
not_fmc_if: Brakes do not stop vehicle.
Vehicle pulls to one side during braking.

checks: Inspect for leakage.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Raise cab; inspect cylinder for leaks/damage and linkage for damage/missing hardware.
not_fmc_if: Class III leak exists or cab will not raise/lower.
Linkage is damaged or hardware is missing.

checks: Inspect latch damage and hose leakage.
not_fmc_if: Class III leak exists and cab will not latch.

checks: Inspect for damage/leaks.
Drain water into a container until clean fuel flows, then close valve.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Inspect for obvious damage and leakage affecting operation.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Check dipstick; maintain between ADD and FULL without overfilling.
Lower cab after required checks.
not_fmc_if: Oil is over FULL, discolored, or milky.
warnings: Avoid shorting dipstick against 24-V starter-solenoid terminals.

checks: At 160-230 F operating temperature, with engine running, check dipstick and maintain between HOT ADD and HOT FULL; shut engine down afterward.
not_fmc_if: Oil is above HOT FULL, discolored, or milky.

checks: Check hydraulic-fluid level per Appendix F Note 3; on a cold check gauge should read two marks above 3/4.
With engine off, listen for tank leakage.
Open drain valves and remove moisture.
not_fmc_if: Air leakage is heard around tanks.

checks: Inspect for missing/underinflated tires, cuts, gouges, cracks, bulges, penetration hazards, and wear bars.
not_fmc_if: A tire is missing, flat, or worn to the wear bar.

checks: Test horn when tactical conditions permit.
Test headlights, signals, tail/stop, marker, blackout-drive, and blackout-marker lamps when tactical conditions permit.
Place all light switches OFF.
Inspect for damage/air leaks, remove dummies and clear obstructions, inspect and lubricate coupler seals.
not_fmc_if: Air leak is heard.
Gladhand is obstructed.
Coupler seal is faulty.

steps.item: Engine-compartment mounting/coupling hardware, hoses, and tubes
checks: Inspect/tighten bolts, nuts, clamps, hoses, and tubes.
Inspect transmission cooling system.
Inspect air-intake system, filter, particle-extraction hose, charge-air tubing, and compressor.
Inspect air dryer/tanks and fuel return/separator-drain hoses.
not_fmc_if: A required part is missing/broken, cannot be tightened, or is damaged enough to leak.

steps.item: Chassis/powertrain mounting hardware, hoses, and tubes
checks: Inspect suspension/springs/U-bolts, axles/vent/CTIS hoses, exhaust, engine mounts, cradle mounts, and driveshaft bearing-cup screws.
not_fmc_if: Engine mount is loose/damaged, bolts are missing, or rubber-mount crack exceeds 50 percent on any side.
Other inspected mounting/coupling damage requires maintenance under the TM general rule.

checks: Operate both directions.
Inspect cable for kinks/frays/breaks and cable-end pin/cotter pin.
warnings: Wear heavy leather-palmed gloves; never slide moving cable through hands.

checks: Test FAN, HEAT, VENT, and DEFROST controls.

steps.item: Wheels, tires, studs, and CTIS pressures
checks: Inspect tread, cuts, cord exposure, bulges, and wheel damage.
Inspect studs/nuts.
Verify pressure within 3 psi of: HWY 55, X-C 33, SAND 20, EMER 14 psi.
not_fmc_if: Tread is at 1/8-inch wear bar or less, damage reaches cord, or bulge exists.
Wheel is cracked, broken, or bent.
Two or more nuts/studs on one wheel are missing, loose, or broken.

checks: Inspect reservoir, hoses, and connections.
Inspect/clean reservoir strainer.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Inspect cases, terminals, mounts, and cable clamps.
Check fluid level; report low or gassing/boiling electrolyte.
Inspect box corrosion and clear drains.
not_fmc_if: A battery is missing, unserviceable, or leaking.
Cable clamp is loose.
notes: Above 90 F ambient, check battery fluid daily.

checks: Inspect for damage and loose mounting.

steps.item: Under-vehicle structure, air lines, shocks, and driveshafts
checks: Inspect leaf springs, engine, transmission, frame rails/crossmembers, welds, and fasteners.
Inspect air hoses/fittings.
Inspect shocks for leakage/security.
Inspect driveshaft hardware and play.
not_fmc_if: Frame rail/crossmember is loose or broken, weld is broken, or structural screw is broken.
Air leak or air-line damage is found.
Shock leak exceeds Class I, hardware is loose/missing, or shock is loose.
Driveshaft hardware is loose.

checks: Inspect accessible electrical connectors for damage and security.
Inspect for damage/air leaks and lubricate coupler seals.
not_fmc_if: Air leak is heard.

checks: Inspect for missing/damaged reflectors.
Inspect looseness and locking-mechanism damage.
Inspect shackles and mounting pins for damage.
Verify cable guides/fairlead rollers are secure and turn smoothly.
Inspect for loose parts, oil leaks, and external damage.

steps.item: Fuel tank, cap, strainer, hoses, and connections
checks: Inspect strainer, cap, tank, hoses, connections, damage, and leaks.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.
warnings: No smoking, flame, fueling with engine running, overfill, or unrecovered spill.

checks: Inspect condition and operation.
Raise cab safely.
Inspect belts for cracks/frays/breaks and about 1/2-inch play.
not_fmc_if: A belt has more than one crack at least 1/8 inch deep or 50 percent of belt thickness.
A fray exceeds 2 inches.
Any belt has excessive play.
warnings: Engine/fan may be hot and fan is partially exposed.

checks: Inspect mounting hardware.
not_fmc_if: Mounting hardware is missing or loose.

checks: Inspect hoses, clamps, leaks, excessive wear, radiator leakage, and fin damage.
not_fmc_if: Class III leak is present at hose/radiator.

checks: Inspect for damage/leakage.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Inspect for damage/leaks.
Maintain dipstick level between MIN and MAX; report overfull condition.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Inspect clamps/hoses at filter, turbo inlet, charge-air cooler, and cooler-to-inlet tubes.
not_fmc_if: A clamp is missing or cannot be tightened.
Any inspected hose is damaged.

checks: Lower tire; inspect tread/damage/penetration hazards.
Inflate to 60 psi.
Secure retainer in UP position.
not_fmc_if: Tread is at 1/8-inch wear bar or less, damage reaches cord, or bulge exists.
Retainer will not lock UP.

checks: Inspect cylinder mounts/hardware, cylinder, and injection valve.
Inspect upper/lower mounting bolts and latch looseness/binding.
Test operation when tactical conditions permit.
Inspect for leakage.
not_fmc_if: Class III leakage is present.

checks: Install handle and pump 5-8 cycles to lubricate seals.
Inspect for water/damage and clean as required.
Fully pay out and inspect wire rope to applicable inspection criteria.
Inspect winch mounting hardware.
not_fmc_if: Wire rope fails inspection criteria.

checks: Lubricate fitting per Appendix F Note 11.
Lubricate per Appendix F Note 9.
Lubricate per Appendix F Note 10.
Lubricate every point listed in Appendix F Note 5.
Inspect switch attachment.
Power system, set alarm ON, verify audible cab alarm, then return alarm and master power OFF.

steps.item: Light Material Handling Crane (LMHC), if equipped
checks: Inspect/tighten drive-motor bolts.
Test cable pay-out/reel-in and rotate crane both ways without binding.
Inspect cable for kinks, frays, and breaks.
not_fmc_if: Cable has kinks, frays, or breaks.
steps.conditional: LMHC equipped and required for mission
warnings: Wear heavy leather-palmed gloves around wire rope.

checks: Inspect boom, turret, winch, mast, welds, power-cord insulation, and three securing pins.
not_fmc_if: Structure is damaged or weld is broken.
Bare wire is exposed.
A required pin is missing or damaged.

checks: Inspect bed mounting screws, under-bed stowage panels, lifting beams/lock pins, spreader bars, and tiedown rings.
not_fmc_if: Any bed mounting screw is broken or missing.
Mission requires lifting beam and it or its lock pin is missing/damaged.

checks: Inspect for bending/damage, hinge damage/broken welds, and missing/damaged latches; verify secure latching raised.
not_fmc_if: A side/tailgate hinge is damaged or weld is broken.
A latch is missing/damaged or cannot secure the side/tailgate raised.

checks: Remove ladder, inspect for cracked/broken welds, and stow correctly.
Inspect drop legs/hinge pins, seat/backrest, and retaining belts in raised/lowered positions.
not_fmc_if: A drop leg is bent/damaged.
A hinge pin is missing.
Seat or backrest is damaged.

checks: Inspect bows/braces, cover tears/seams, hooks, tiedown straps, and safety straps.
not_fmc_if: A required safety strap is missing or damaged.

steps.item: LMHC cable, mounting, and electrical system, if equipped
checks: Inspect corrosion/cracks/mounting.
Fully pay out cable and inspect kinks, bends, abrasion, broken wires, crushing/distortion.
Inspect overload-box connectors and cables.
not_fmc_if: LMHC is damaged or insecurely mounted.
Cable is damaged/excessively worn, has six distributed broken wires in 6 inches, three broken wires in one strand/bundle in 6 inches, or is distorted by kinking/crushing.
Wiring is frayed, cracked, or excessively worn.
warnings: Wear heavy leather-palmed gloves around wire rope.

summary.filtering_guidance: Use table, interval, global_rank, and conditional fields. Retain both Table 2-1 and Table 2-2 records for an M1078.
